snapshot.name: Kaynes Technology India Ltd
snapshot.about: Incorporated in 2008, Kaynes Technology is a leading end-to-end and IoT solutions-enabled integrated electronics manufacturing company. The company provides conceptual design, process engineering, integrated manufacturing, and life-cycle support for major players in the automotive, industrial, aerospace and defense, outer-space, nuclear, medical, railways, Internet of Things ("IoT"), Information Technology ("IT") and other segments. [1]

narrative_vs_numbers.management_says: Profitability is expected to normalize and return to committed levels in a couple of quarters.
narrative_vs_numbers.numbers_say: Operating profit dropped to 120.0 and OPM% declined to 13.0% in Sep 2026, showing ongoing margin compression.

promises.credibility: Management routinely points to long-term and future-year targets such as $1 billion by FY28, while near-term margins continue to face downward pressure with OPM dropping to 13.0% in Sep 2026.

bull: Margins are expanding with an OPM of 16% compared to the 13% average of prior years.
Profit is outgrowing revenue, showing a 3-year PAT CAGR of 56% versus 48% for revenue.
Growth capacity is being built with CWIP representing 34% of fixed assets for future operations.
bear: Revenue growth is slowing, dropping from a 5-year CAGR of 54% to 48% over 3 years.
Free cash flow is negative, totaling ₹-3,288 Cr and remaining negative in 5 out of 5 years.
Working capital is stretching significantly as the cash conversion cycle increased from 123 to 193 days.
